skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Attack a single target with 2 consecutive strikes for 120% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deal 4 consecutive hits to the entire enemy row, causing Direct DMG equal to 900% ATK. Make same-row teammates permanently gain [Specialized Speed Up]. Make all allies gain [Speed Field Attack] for 3 rounds. — [Specialized Speed Up]: Speed is increased to 94% of Sonic's; if the teammate's own speed is higher, it stays unchanged. [Speed Field Attack]: when attacking in PvP, if the target's speed is not higher than the attacker's, total DMG to the target is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Ultimate DMG 900% > 1160% ATK. [Specialized Speed Up] to 94% > 98% of Sonic's speed. [Speed Field Attack] DMG increase 20% > 30%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Instant DMG Evasion] at the start of battle. Immune to [Deterrence], [Stun] and [Specialized Stun]. — [Instant DMG Evasion]: Direct DMG, Ex. DMG, Charge DMG and Berserk DMG only deal 1 DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: On entry, increases own [Specialized Speed] by 39% and teammates' by 20%. All allies permanently gain 30% [Speed Field Defense]. Before battle, [Encourage] the team (gain 2 extra energy for 3 rounds at the start of the round). — [Speed Field Defense]: when attacked in PvP, if the attacker's speed is not higher than the defender's, DMG received is reduced.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Own [Specialized Speed] 35% > 42%. Allies' [Specialized Speed] 20% > 30%. [Speed Field Defense] 30% > 40% (others), 60% for Sonic.

effects.desc: The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Power up at the beginning of each round for several rounds.
The stun control effect renders the target unable to act and reduces its overall damage immunity by 30%.
